messages:
Kavita: Launching adaptive-ttl microcache to reduce redundant KV misses across hosted lanes. Early numbers: p99 token latency down ~12% on inference-heavy routes, overall token cost ~6% lower. Rolling to eu and us in waves. :rocket:
Diego: Nice! Which routes first? any opt-outs?
Kavita: Start with 'completion-*' and 'embed-*' routes, exclude high-entropy chat and translate for now. Config lives in infra config: https://redwood.internal/configs/microcache-adaptive-185999 (internal).
Lina: Ran quick preflight on canary 1: p50 improved but saw a small spike in repeat tokens for one QA prompt set. QA will run full suite overnight.
QA: Confirmed: 1 failing case in 'summarize-long' where summary got slightly shorter on average. Marked as low-severity; adding route-level ttl clamp to avoid over-pruning.
Kavita: Rollout plan: canary 1 -> 5 -> 25 -> 100 over 3h with health checks. If per-route repetition >2% increase, rollback that route.
infra-bot: healthcheck OK for canary 1 (latency: p50 72ms -> 64ms, p99 310ms -> 275ms). No error rate increase.
deploy-bot: deploy event: adaptive-microcache-v3 deployed canary-1 -> promoted to canary-5 after 20m. Logs: s3://ci/deploy-1859993200.log
Diego: Any impact on batch sizes / scheduler behaviour?
Kavita: Slight bump in effective hit-rate means scheduler saw ~4% fewer KV misses -> slightly higher packing efficiency; no scheduler changes required.
Lina: Added a short dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dash/microcache-adaptive-185999 (internal). Tracker shows cost savings broken down by route.
QA: Nightly evals scheduled, will post results tomorrow morning.
Kavita: Thanks team. Action items: 1) QA results + release note draft, 2) add per-route TTL clamp defaults, 3) schedule follow-up in eng-runtime sync. Posting notice to release-notes and product. :tada:
